name: SimpliContract
description_en:
SimpliContract is an enterprise contract-intelligence and orchestration platform powered by mNemoAI. It distinguishes Contract Intelligence, Contract Performance Management and Contract Orchestration, so it covers both creating agreements and using their commercial terms after signature.

Its particular emphasis is connecting contractual pricing, obligations and agreement hierarchies to operational data. RateIQ applies the engine to rate governance. That is more specific than a generic contract-summary chatbot, but the accuracy and financial effects are vendor claims rather than independently tested results here.
description_zh:
SimpliContract 是由 mNemoAI 驱动的企业合同智能及流程平台，区分 Contract Intelligence、Contract Performance Management 和 Contract Orchestration，既覆盖协议创建，也使用签后的商业条款。

它尤其强调把合同价格、义务及协议层级连接运营数据，RateIQ 将该引擎用于费率治理。这比通用合同摘要聊天更具体，但准确率和财务效果属于厂商主张，并非本文独立测试结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Normalize master agreements, work statements, orders and amendments into related contract data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把主协议、工作说明书、订单及补充协议转成关联数据。

core_features.explanation_en: The platform describes comparing invoiced pricing with structured contractual rate logic.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台介绍将发票价格与结构化合同费率逻辑核对。

core_features.explanation_en: Route approvals by value, risk, geography or contract type.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按金额、风险、地区或合同类型路由审批。

sections.title_en: Check an invoice against the operative rate agreement
sections.title_zh: 把发票与当前有效费率协议核对
sections.en: A proposed RateIQ evaluation could include a services rate card, a dated escalation amendment and an invoice. mNemoAI describes ingesting PDFs, Word files, scans and annexures, then structuring clauses, timelines and relationships. Confirm the applicable date, unit, currency and amendment before judging a price deviation. A flagged difference may need a business explanation; the ability to compare rates is not proof that every apparent overcharge is recoverable.
sections.zh: RateIQ 评估可准备服务费率表、注明日期的调价补充协议及发票。mNemoAI 介绍导入 PDF、Word、扫描件和附件，再结构化条款、时间线及关联。判断价格偏差前，先确认生效日期、单位、币种及补充协议。标记差异可能需要业务解释，能比较费率不等于每笔疑似多收费都可追回。

sections.title_en: Separate intelligence from performance and orchestration
sections.title_zh: 区分智能分析、履约管理和流程
sections.en: Contract Intelligence extracts and searches terms and relationships. Performance Management describes obligations, rebates, SLAs and contract-to-invoice reconciliation. Orchestration addresses intake, drafting, negotiation, approvals and signature. These are related modules, not evidence that an unspecified subscription includes every capability. Begin with the operational question and identify the module and source data needed.
sections.zh: Contract Intelligence 用于条款及关联的提取搜索；Performance Management 描述义务、返利、SLA 和合同发票核对；Orchestration 覆盖申请、起草、谈判、审批及签署。它们属于关联模块，不证明某个未明确的订阅包含全部能力。应从运营问题出发，确定所需模块和源数据。

sections.title_zh: 提取信息后仍需约束操作
sections.en: mNemoAI is described as using agents to monitor contracts and trigger workflows or actions. Define which outputs are advisory, which may create a task and which need approval before changing an enterprise record. Use a missing annex, conflicting obligation and revised rate as evaluation cases. No agent execution, ERP synchronization or reconciliation accuracy was tested.
sections.zh: mNemoAI 描述由 Agent 监控合同并触发流程或操作。应区分建议性输出、可创建任务的输出，以及修改企业记录前必须审批的操作。评估可采用附件缺失、义务冲突和费率修订情形。本文未测试 Agent 执行、ERP 同步或核对准确率。

sections.title_en: Commercial and deployment scope remain sales-led
sections.title_zh: 商业及部署范围需向销售确认
sections.en: The official site directs buyers to a meeting and demo form. No public numeric price, billing unit or complete licence/deployment offer was verified, so price remains unknown rather than guessed per user or per contract. Ask for modules, documents, ERP connections, operational data feeds, AI usage, implementation and ongoing support in a scoped proposal. A demo request does not establish trial or free-production terms.
sections.zh: 官网引导预约会议和演示表单。未核实公开金额、计费单位或完整许可／部署方案，因此保留价格未知，不猜测按用户或合同收费。应在明确范围的方案中询问模块、文档、ERP 连接、运营数据、AI 用量、实施及持续支持。申请演示不能证明试用或免费生产条件。

sections.title_en: Needs both contract owners and operational data owners
sections.title_zh: 同时需要合同负责人和运营数据负责人
sections.en: Procurement and finance with complex rates, rebates or obligations have a concrete reason to evaluate the system. A small one-off signature task may not benefit from contract-data reconciliation. Prepare an agreement hierarchy, source-of-truth rules and a way to resolve exceptions. Hosting region, open-source status, export completeness and recovery commitments remain unverified. This profile does not claim recovered savings.
sections.zh: 费率、返利或义务复杂的采购及财务团队有具体评估理由。一次性签署任务可能无需合同数据核对。应准备协议层级、权威来源规则及例外解决方法。托管地区、开源状态、导出完整性及恢复承诺仍未核实，本文不声称已经追回费用。
